description: Remove the code component mapping saved by add_code_connect_map, so get_design_context stops naming that code component. Pass an instance, component or component set id. Only the local mapping file changes, never the design; returns how many mappings were removed (0 when none existed). Add it again with add_code_connect_map to undo.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file. Accepted for compatibility; the file open in Figma Desktop is always used.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node, eg. "123:456" or "123-456" (instance ids like "I1:2;3:4" work too). Omit it to use the current selection in Figma.

name: remove_code_connect_map
title: Remove Code Connect Mapping
